street_vendor_cries: Hot pretzels! Twisted fresh, salted heavy!
Lemon ice, hon! Coldest cup on the block!
Snowballs! Marshmallow on top, no extra!
Fresh peaches off the truck, two for one!
Sunglasses! Look cool, pay less, hon!
Roasted peanuts, still warm in the bag!
Batteries, chargers, cables, I got it all!
Umbrellas! Five bucks before it pours!
Hot dogs, half smokes, mustard's free!
Fresh flowers for your mother, sweetheart!
Cold water! Cold soda! Cold everything!
Funnel cake, powdered sugar on the house!
Watermelon slices, sweet as a Sunday!
Corn on the cob, butter dripping, step up!
Phone cases! Sturdy enough for a bus fall!
tunnel_traffic_lines: Tunnel lights flicker. Radio goes to static.
Brake lights stretch all the way to the toll.
Somebody honks. The whole tunnel answers back.
Lane closed ahead. Merge like you mean it.
No changing lanes in the tube, pal. Sit tight.
Exhaust fans roar overhead like a jet engine.
Toll plaza ahead. Hope you saved your change.
Daylight at the end. Floor it, gently.
Under the harbor now. Try not to think about it.
Stalled van, right lane. Of course it is.
Tunnel echo makes your engine sound tougher.
Out of the tube and straight into a jam.
taxi_passenger_lines: Take the long way. I'm not in a hurry.
Was that light red? Asking for my nerves.
Just drop me by the corner store, hon.
Can you turn the radio up? That's my song.
I'm late! Drive like rent depends on it!
You missed the turn. And the next one.
Is it always this bumpy, or just you?
Five stars if we survive this, deal?
My cousin drives too. Way slower than you.
Pull over here. No, here. No, back there.
Keep the change. Buy some brake pads.
Smooth ride. Mostly. Okay, kind of.
rainy_day_ambient_lines: Rain drums on the rowhouse awnings.
Gutters gurgle. The whole street smells wet.
Puddles swallow the neon signs whole.
Somebody's steps are a waterfall now.
Pigeons huddle under the bus shelter.
Wipers squeak. Traffic crawls. Thunder too.
A newspaper hat floats by in the gutter.
Umbrellas bloom all down the avenue.
Storm drains sing a low, gargling tune.
game_over_screen_quips: Well, that went south fast, hon.
The block will remember this. Fondly.
Dust off. Try again. Stoop's waiting.
That's a rough one. Shake it off.
Back to the corner. Rethink everything.
